questions.question: What does Yuki Tsukumo look like?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Yuki is a very tall young woman with a slender yet athletic build and light skin. She has long blonde hair that extends well down her back with two tufts on in front of each side of her face. She has wide brown (pink in the manga) eyes with thin eyebrows and pronounced eyelashes.

questions.question: What outfit does Yuki wear in the anime?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: She has sported a few different outfits, but currently appears in the anime with a sleeveless, heather indigo top reminiscent of female Chinese martial artists' attire with a gold mandarin collar. The vest is tucked into high-waisted stone blue jeans. Most of her stomach area is covered with a buttoned grey bodice. She finishes this outfit with a pair of brown heeled boots.

questions.question: What does Yuki wear during the Culling Game?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: During the Culling Game, Yuki wears a black sleeveless turtleneck top with a zipper on the neck and the Jujutsu High crest on the zipper’s button. This attire continues with red baggy cargo pants, which also carries a button with the same crest, with large black vertical lines on the pockets that has black ribbons attached to the pockets. Finally, this attire is completed with dark-colored boots.

questions.question: How does Yuki get around when she isn't working?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Yuki travels around on a motorbike and wears appropriate attire while she isn't working. She has a leather biker jacket, with a dome helmet and goggles.

questions.question: What was Yuki wearing when she first met Suguru Geto in 2007?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: In 2007 when Yuki first met Suguru Geto she wore a heather indigo sleeveless turtleneck top, dark blue jeans with a black belt and black combat boots for a more casual look than her current, more battle-oriented one.

questions.question: What did Yuki wear when she introduced herself to a young Aoi Todo?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: She wore this same outfit a few years later when she introduced herself to a young Aoi Todo, except she wore a black fishnet top with a black leather jacket and black gloves.

questions.question: What is Yuki Tsukumo's overall skill level?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Yuki is an extremely powerful fighter, one of only four registered special grade sorcerers who possesses incredibly unorthodox abilities.

questions.question: What did Jujutsu Headquarters know about Yuki's powers?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Jujutsu Headquarters knew next to nothing about Yuki's powers despite designating her special grade but she has shown up for her allies and showcased her abilities against some of the strongest opponents available.

questions.question: What abilities is Yuki Tsukumo capable of using?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Yuki possesses elite combat instincts and is highly talented in jujutsu, capable of using her innate technique, barrier techniques, and domain expansion.

questions.question: Is Yuki a teacher at Jujutsu High?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: She's also fully capable of instructing students and fostering elite talent despite not being a teacher at Jujutsu High.

questions.question: Who did Yuki Tsukumo mentor into a grade 1 sorcerer?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Yuki introduced Aoi Todo to jujutsu and mentored him into the exceptional grade 1 sorcerer he's flourished into.

questions.question: How was Yuki's training of Aoi Todo?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Her training was extremely grueling, enough so to physically scar Todo for life.

questions.question: What has Aoi Todo shown from Yuki's imparted knowledge?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Todo has shown the fruits of her imparted knowledge time and time again, including learning to use Simple Domain from her.

questions.question: How did Yuki repel Uraume's Icefall?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Yuki displayed her own strength when she effortlessly repelled Uraume's Icefall technique using only Garuda.

questions.question: Who saved the sorcerers that Uraume had overpowered?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Uraume had overpowered a large group of sorcerers on their own who were all saved by Yuki's intervention.

questions.question: What did Yuki's first attack do against Kenjaku?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Yuki used her full strength against Kenjaku and effortlessly exorcised one of his special grade curses with her first attack.

questions.question: What did Yuki's second attack do to Kenjaku?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Her second attack sent Kenjaku flying and made him question whether he could even tame the wild beast known as Yuki Tsukumo.

questions.question: Why did Kenjaku's domain expansion severely injure Yuki?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Kenjaku's domain expansion severely injured Tsukumo only because she chose to rely on Tengen's help and their countermeasures had a severe miscalculation.

questions.question: How did Yuki's simple domain compare to Kenjaku's domain?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Yuki's simple domain couldn't stand up to Kenjaku's domain but using her domain would've likely ended with a different outcome.

questions.question: How did Yuki drive Kenjaku into a corner?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Yuki continued fighting despite her injuries, and with Choso's help, she drove the curse user into a corner.

questions.question: How did Yuki fight alongside Choso?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Despite initially believing Choso would only hold her back, Yuki fought effectively alongside Choso even while her body was mangled and proficiently utilized reverse cursed technique to heal herself while Choso was holding their opponent off.

questions.question: What happened when Yuki regained momentum after healing?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Once healed, Yuki quickly regained momentum with her pure destructive power but Kenjaku outwitted her and dealt an unexpected fatal blow.

questions.question: What did Yuki do at the end of her fight with Kenjaku?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Yuki fought to the end and used her innate technique to transform into a black hole with the potential to destroy the world. She suppressed its power using her will and prevented a catastrophe, impressing even the callous Kenjaku.

questions.question: What kind of combatant is Yuki?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Yuki is primarily a close-quarters combatant who supplements her martial arts with her innate technique to unleash devastating attacks.

questions.question: How did Yuki's first hand-to-hand exchange with Kenjaku go?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: In her first hand-to-hand exchange with Kenjaku, she was able to use a single punch to literally break through his guard and send him flying.

questions.question: How did Yuki keep Kenjaku on the defensive?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Yuki kept Kenjaku, an excellent taijutsu user, on the defensive throughout most of their hand-to-hand combat exchanges.

questions.question: What could Yuki still do with a broken arm?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Even with a broken arm and numerous other injuries, Yuki was able to pressure Kenjaku with flurries of kicks and other improvised attacks.

questions.question: What did a fully healed Yuki do to Kenjaku?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: A fully healed Yuki easily outmaneuvered Kenjaku at close range and nearly defeated him.

questions.question: How durable is Yuki?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Yuki is exceptionally durable for a human being and has a high pain tolerance.

questions.question: What injuries did Yuki suffer from Womb Profusion?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: She suffered a direct hit from Womb Profusion that dealt her a serious head injury as well as a completely shattered right arm.

questions.question: How did Yuki keep fighting despite her injuries?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Not only was Yuki able to move despite her injuries, but she kept her innate technique active and fought Kenjaku on even terms in hand-to-hand combat.

questions.question: How did Yuki use her mangled body to pressure Kenjaku?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: While her body quickly reached its limit due to her injuries, Yuki fought through them and continued to use her mangled body to pressure Kenjaku alongside Choso.

questions.question: How did Yuki fight until the very end?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Yuki even managed to move and activate with her body bifurcated, fighting until the very end.

questions.question: How smart is Yuki?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: While her wits are not always on display due to her straightforward attitude, Yuki is as smart as she is strong and goes into every situation with a considerable amount of thought.

questions.question: How does Yuki analyze her opponents?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Using her advanced knowledge of jujutsu, Yuki vigorously analyzes her opponent's every move throughout a battle, taking mental notes of every technique used and every countermeasure that is taken.

questions.question: What did Yuki recognize about Ganesha at a glance?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: As a testament to her jujutsu-related knowledge and intuition, Yuki was able to recognize Ganesha was a cursed spirit foreign to Japan with a single glance.

questions.question: How did Yuki figure out Kenjaku could manipulate gravity?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: It only took a single activation for Yuki to figure out Kenjaku could manipulate gravity.

questions.question: What did further observation of Kenjaku reveal to Yuki?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Further observation of Kenjaku's technique allowed Yuki to figure out its effective range as well as the time needed between activation intervals.

questions.question: What plan did Yuki and Tengen work out to deal with Kenjaku?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Yuki worked with Tengen to formulate a multi-layered plan to deal with Kenjaku that was nearly successful in several facets.

questions.question: Why did Yuki keep fighting through her physical trauma?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Although the second phase of their plan was miscalculated and Yuki didn't escape Kenjaku's domain unharmed, she knew she needed to keep fighting through her physical trauma so Choso could ambush him in the next phase.

questions.question: What did Yuki deduce when Kenjaku survived the ambush?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: When Kenjaku survived the ambush, Yuki quickly deduced how he managed to avoid a fatal blow.

questions.question: What would have happened if Yuki's technique had been at full power?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: She also recognized he would've died if her technique was at full power and that he was still cornered regardless.

questions.question: What mistakes did Yuki make against Kenjaku?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: she assumed Star Rage could power through any resistance from Cursed Spirit Manipulation. While this was a safe assumption, it was reckless and turned out to be incorrect, which Yuki herself realized and admitted.

questions.question: What did Yuki do even in defeat?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Even in defeat, Yuki quickly improvised a maneuver to take her opponent down with her in a last-ditch effort to do what was necessary for the greater good.

questions.question: How is Yuki's control over cursed energy?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Yuki has remarkable control over her cursed energy, as the rare skill to use reverse cursed technique requires extremely precise cursed energy manipulation.

questions.question: How much cursed energy does Yuki have?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Yuki possesses a high amount of cursed energy, demonstrated by her ability to perform domain expansion, which requires exceptional levels of cursed energy and control over it.

questions.question: What binding vow does Yuki Tsukumo use?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: A commonly used binding vow by many jujutsu practitioners. By divulging how her cursed technique works, Yuki can increase the effectiveness of her technique.

questions.question: What does Star Rage do?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Yuki's innate technique allows her to grant virtual mass to herself and her shikigami, Garuda.

questions.question: What does the mass added by Star Rage give Yuki and Garuda's attacks?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: The mass added to Yuki and Garuda's attacks gives them devastating destructive force, capable of effortlessly exorcising a special grade curse.

questions.question: How does Yuki use reverse cursed technique?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Yuki is able to utilize reverse cursed technique to heal herself. She has used this during her fight against Kenjaku after she was severely damaged by the sure-hit technique of his Womb Profusion.

questions.question: What is Yuki's shikigami directly connected to?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Yuki's shikigami is directly connected to her innate technique.

questions.question: What does Star Rage turn Garuda into?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: By having virtual mass added to it by Star Rage, Garuda becomes a cursed tool for Yuki to utilize in battle.

questions.question: What can Garuda do on its own?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Garuda can also fight and restrain Yuki's opponents independently, creating situations where they fight side-by-side.

questions.question: What is Simple Domain?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: An anti-domain technique that nullifies a domain expansion's sure-hit effect by neutralizing its barrier.

questions.question: Who did Yuki teach Simple Domain to?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Yuki also taught Aoi Todo how to use this technique.

questions.question: What stripped away Yuki's Simple Domain against Kenjaku?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Against Kenjaku, Yuki's Simple Domain was quickly stripped away by Womb Profusion.

questions.question: What is Yuki's domain expansion?
questions.subject: Yuki Tsukumo

answer.item: Yuki can expand her innate domain and imbue it with her innate technique. It was never displayed but Yuki spoke about it with Tengen while planning to fight against Kenjaku.
